lines: 昨天是沙拉斯老师的生日。
他的一生，大家都很熟悉，
他的人生故事，2000年前就写好了。
在古老的伟大史诗《摩诃婆罗多》里，
有个男孩，生下来身上有8处是弯的。
他还在妈妈肚子里，就听到父亲在唱诵。
结果孩子一生下来，身体就是弯的。
于是外公把他抱在腿上养大。
守卫说：“回家吧，你太小了。”
男孩说：“头发白了不算老，
出来时，弯曲的身体变直了。
他说：“我常从后门溜出去，
他外公是Guruji，帕塔比·乔伊斯。
天还没亮，他就开始练习。
“我能感觉到身体在康复、在修复。”
沙拉斯老师扛起了整个道场。
我请他来曼谷教课时，来了500人。
就在那年11月，他离开了我们。
也许今天，你觉得身体是弯的。
不是身体强壮了，才能练习，
而是练习，让身体变强壮。
你用双臂把自己撑起来。
八曲仙人，曾是个身体弯曲的男孩。
沙拉斯老师，曾是个体弱多病的男孩。
是练习让他们俩都变强了。
那个坐在外公腿上的男孩，
昨天，沙拉斯老师本该满55岁。

post_caption:
一个男孩生来身上8处弯曲，一个男孩从小总是生病。
阿斯汤加背后的故事 · 第3集：八曲仙人，献给沙拉斯（Sharath）老师
八曲式A和B，都在高级A序列（第三序列）里。
不是身体强壮了，才能练习；而是练习，让身体变强壮。

9月29日，他本该满55岁。沙拉斯老师，生日快乐。🙏

片中沙拉斯老师的八曲式，来自他1999年的高级A序列练习视频。

notes:
There are 60 lines, in order and one-to-one with the English. Every line is 20 characters or fewer counting punctuation, which puts it between 5 and 19. Quotes use “” throughout.

Fixes applied from the reviewers:
- Line 6: added 有.
- Line 9: changed to 他还在妈妈肚子里…
- Line 12: added 结果…一.
- Lines 13 and 56: changed 膝上 to 腿上.
- Line 19: changed 比试 to 辩论.
- Line 28: changed to 我外婆Amma.
- Line 37 and card heal_q2: changed 愈合 to 康复.
- Line 43: changed to 请他来曼谷教课.
- Line 44: changed 回到 to 来到.
- Line 45: changed 同年 to 就在那年.
- Line 47: changed the semicolon to a comma.
- Lines 53 and 54: added 曾.
- Card eight_3: now reads Ashtavakra 八曲仙人.
- Post caption:
  - Sharath's name is paired as 沙拉斯（Sharath） at its first mention.
  - 影片 changed to 视频, using the 片中 wording.
  - #Sharath replaced with #SharathJois.
  - Added #八角式 and #印度神话.

Where the two reviewers disagreed:
1) Line 39 (shala): the terminology reviewer wanted "shala" left in English or rendered as 研究院. The style reviewer wanted 扛起了 instead of 把…扛在了肩上. I combined them as 沙拉斯老师扛起了整个道场。 AYBKK's own Chinese pages already use 道场 for a traditional shala (for example 在道场由传承老师指导的传统练习). A 12-year-old understands 道场, while 学院 reads as "college".
2) Line 4: I added 伟大 back for accuracy ("great old story book"). For the maha_sub card I took the style reviewer's 古印度的伟大史诗, which avoids stacking two adjectives and still says both "great" and "old".
3) Card years_sub: I used 他出生很久以前，就有人讲过他的故事. It keeps "long" (terminology), removes the vague 他之前 (style) and gives the sentence a subject (有人讲过), so no one reads it as Sharath telling the story himself.
4) Card mysore_sub: I used 每天早上来到迈索尔的学生. It keeps "came" (terminology) and is a plain noun phrase under the 300到400 title (style). I did not add 练习, because the English does not say it.
5) Caption call to action: I removed the URL, because on Xiaohongshu a link in the post body can cut the note's reach. I did not use the style reviewer's "来曼谷", because the original only says "come study Ashtanga" and Boonchu also teaches in China. The new line is 想跟我学阿斯汤加，欢迎私信。 Put cn.aybkk.net, the China-accessible site, in the profile bio rather than Aybkk.com. On Instagram, the URL can go back in.

Still to check before posting:
(a) The caption says the pose clip comes from a 1999 Advanced A practice video. No English line in the video confirms that year.
(b) The repo has no record of Ep. 1 or Ep. 2. Check that 阿斯汤加背后的故事 matches the Chinese series title used for those episodes.
(c) Lines 38 and 30 are 19 characters each, because the letters in "Guruji" count one by one. On screen they look shorter.
